scope: Offline source inspection, synthetic official DRIFT orchestration, exact preflight reconstruction, existing report-vector reads and budget arithmetic. No paid execution approval is implied.

independent_reconstruction.cohorts: Original main20 and supplemental6 stay separate. Q01/Q07/Q13 reuse the same new answer in both views; only F02-plan/G01/G02 add unique queries.

official_call_bound.embedding_explanation: One HyDE answer embedding plus one embedding for each of at most four Local subqueries. Reusing report embeddings does not remove these dynamic embeddings. Local vector retrieval is source-inspected; the mock uses a stub for that component.
official_call_bound.global_conditions: Static level0 selection, dynamic_community_selection=False, fixed four batches, allow_general_knowledge=False. A no-positive-map-points result may skip reduce and use fewer calls.
official_call_bound.depth_meaning: Two epochs choosing at most two actions each from all incomplete actions. This is not a guarantee of following a two-hop chain; the second epoch can select remaining primer siblings.
official_call_bound.concurrency: DRIFT uses gather and does not enforce config.concurrency on this path. The paid adapter/runtime must serialize actual generation and embedding dispatch and hold its lock through reservation and completion.

budget_recalculation.new_embedding_items_equation: 13*(1+4) + 3 = 68; the three newly added original questions share exact embedding cache across methods.
conditions: 1883 contains no spare probe, administrative reservation or extra diagnostic generation allowance. All reservations, including unsent administrative reservations, still count against the fixed cap.

The 64k cap is cumulative common-encoding generation input for each question-method cell, including all subcalls and all dispatched or conservatively reserved retries; it is not 64k per individual request.
A cell can exhaust 64k before its full retry allowance is consumed. Record failure and retain the original denominator; do not switch strategy or silently omit the cell.
Per-request 16k generation-input and 8000 embedding-token bounds must be enforced before dispatch, including generated HyDE text and follow-up questions.
The 68 embedding bound requires exact original-query text reuse across methods and no hidden embedding of alternate query forms or instructions.
2048 is only requested output. Known upstream overruns make a hard total generation-dollar or output-token guarantee invalid. Unknown usage remains unknown.

execution_requirements_not_yet_validated.finding: The existing full_runtime completion adapter cannot be reused unchanged: it rejects DRIFT stream/temperature/top_p/n/max_completion_tokens/response_format_json_object kwargs and replaces any response_format with the community REPORT_SCHEMA. The old Global adapter likewise lacks PrimerResponse handling.
execution_requirements_not_yet_validated.required: Use a dedicated routing adapter accepting exactly the observed official arguments, supporting PrimerResponse and Local async chunks. Validate its actual transmitted payload and structured result offline before dispatch; preserve stop escalation past upstream catch(Exception).

execution_requirements_not_yet_validated.finding: Official DRIFT data_max_tokens, primer_llm_max_tokens and concurrency fields do not enforce the proposed total, primer input or dispatch concurrency in this code path. Reduce concatenates all available answers without a token truncation guard.
execution_requirements_not_yet_validated.required: Enforce per-request16k, per-cell64k, carried total input/call/embedding limits and concurrency1 in the new runtime before every physical dispatch. Freeze the failure behavior and test its boundaries.

execution_requirements_not_yet_validated.finding: DRIFTSearch retains QueryState and skips priming once its graph is nonempty. Reusing one engine across independent questions would leak prior answers and contexts.
execution_requirements_not_yet_validated.required: Instantiate a fresh DRIFT engine/state per question; give each question its own deterministic selection state and isolated budget counters.

execution_requirements_not_yet_validated.finding: The arithmetic assumes no repeated successful subrequest is sent during resume and no repeated failed subrequest exceeds its shared allowance.
execution_requirements_not_yet_validated.required: Persist exact request-body and schema cache keys, deterministic template/action state and per-cell counters. Replay successes exactly; transient categories share at most three physical attempts, honoring Retry-After and preserving unknown usage. Do not route elsewhere after budget/parser failure.

execution_requirements_not_yet_validated.finding: The proposed 1883 generation reservation ceiling is an increase of283 over the existing1600. This audit validates the arithmetic, not authorization of that increase.
execution_requirements_not_yet_validated.required: Keep paid execution stopped until the parent confirms the specific amendment is authorized.

fairness_and_disclosure: Treat text-routed Local/Global/DRIFT as one fixed method. Routing code reads question text only and is frozen before new outputs; no all-strategy cross-product or best-result selection.
This is a follow-up study designed after earlier results were inspected, not a newly unseen benchmark. Keep main20 and supplemental6 separate and disclose their three overlapping questions.

Common input ceilings are equal maximum budgets, not equal actual computation: BM25/Basic/hybrid normally generate once while DRIFT and Global consume multiple calls and different source/report mixes. Report actual total input, output, calls, embeddings and elapsed time per cell.

Freeze baseline context/token budgets and Basic k10 before generation. Reuse the same source text/vector snapshot; retain same evidence provenance for all source excerpts. Gold must be absent from routing, retrieval and model messages.

Official DRIFT prompts allow general knowledge. If baselines are evidence-only, add the same frozen evidence restriction to every strategy subcall, including HyDE, primer, Local and reduce, and disclose that prompt adaptation.

Official HyDE uses secrets.choice, which random.seed and PYTHONHASHSEED do not control. A frozen sha256(seed:raw_query:report_id) template choice and a question-specific random.Random for action shuffle are reproducibility adaptations, not untouched upstream randomness. Record actual chosen IDs and action order.

PrimerResponse is a Pydantic model with coercion and no strict score-range/length constraints. Local actions use try_parse_json_object, which can clean/repair malformed JSON and accept duplicate last values; this is not strict schema validation. Save original response, parsed value and any transformation, and stop on unsupported parsing failures without another paid request.
The pre-existing code graph includes disclosed report-format repairs and four upstream-loose report parses. Reuse it unchanged and carry these limitations into this new comparison.

DRIFT SearchResult.context_data contains Local action contexts, not the full primer/HyDE report input. Preserve every stage request/response and original report/source mapping; do not infer all exposed evidence from final context_data alone.

Official DRIFT SearchResult.completion_time is computed before reduce. Measure end-to-end time externally through final reduce, and count tokens from the runtime ledger because upstream prompt counts can omit user messages.

New answer quality must be scored against a frozen answer rubric; source Recall/coverage from the old retrieval-only study is a different measure. F02-plan is planning only, not patch execution. Negative and failed answers require explicit rubric treatment, not silent exclusion.
mock_interpretation: The official DRIFT orchestration and its typed/stream interface were exercised with synthetic model responses. It proves a call-path bound under the stated configuration, not network compatibility, retrieval quality, budget enforcement, answer accuracy or successful paid execution.
